thing-type.label: Samsung OCF Appliance
thing-type.description: Direct authenticated control of a compatible Samsung appliance. Dynamic channels are created only for recognized appliance resources; descriptions report advertised command values and ranges when available. No SmartThings Hub is required.

parameter.name: host
parameter.label: Appliance Address
parameter.description: Host name or IP address of the appliance on the same network.

parameter.name: port
parameter.label: Secure CoAP Port
parameter.description: Advertised DTLS port. Zero discovers the secure port from this host using public CoAP discovery.

parameter.name: clientPort
parameter.label: Client UDP Port
parameter.description: Client UDP port. Zero selects a deterministic stable port. Use an explicit unused port if multiple Things would conflict.

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Delay between resource polls, in seconds.

parameter.name: timeout
parameter.label: Request Timeout
parameter.description: Maximum duration of each discovery or authenticated CoAP request, in seconds.

parameter.name: deviceId
parameter.label: Expected Device UUID
parameter.description: Optional expected appliance UUID. The authenticated device identity must match; otherwise the first authenticated identity is remembered for this Thing.

parameter.name: keyStore
parameter.label: Client PKCS12 Key Store
parameter.description: Absolute path on the openHAB server to a PKCS12 key store containing one authorized client private key and its certificate chain. Leave empty to generate and retain a client identity automatically.

parameter.name: keyStorePassword
parameter.label: Key Store Password
parameter.description: Password protecting the client PKCS12 key store and private key.

parameter.name: serverFingerprint
parameter.label: Server Certificate SHA-256 Fingerprint
parameter.description: Explicitly trusted appliance leaf certificate fingerprint obtained through an authenticated, out-of-band source. Leave empty to validate against the bundled Samsung OCF CA. Hexadecimal, with optional colon separators.

parameter.name: ownerId
parameter.label: Owner UUID
parameter.description: Owner UUID associated with an imported OwnerPSK. Not the device UUID.

parameter.name: ownerPsk
parameter.label: OwnerPSK
parameter.description: Previously provisioned, authorized owner pre-shared key: 16 or 32 bytes encoded as hexadecimal. Use either this mode or certificate authentication.

channel-type.label: Appliance Switch
channel-type.description: Boolean resource state. Writes are accepted only when live appliance capabilities and Remote Control permit them.

channel-type.label: Appliance Number
channel-type.description: Numeric resource state. The channel description reports validated command ranges when available; otherwise supported command values depend on live device capabilities.

channel-type.label: Appliance Number State
channel-type.description: Read-only numeric resource state. No unit or range is inferred.

channel-type.label: Appliance Temperature
channel-type.description: Temperature in the device-reported unit. Writes require a valid advertised range and increment.

channel-type.label: Appliance Temperature State
channel-type.description: Read-only temperature in the device-reported unit.

channel-type.label: Appliance Setting
channel-type.description: Text resource state. Mode channels report the exact command values advertised by the appliance, with display names when available. Other valid commands depend on live device capabilities.

channel-type.label: Appliance Text State
channel-type.description: Read-only text or JSON representation of a non-security resource.
